Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. During the Middle Ages, the term 'Christon' was sometimes used as a synonym for 'Christendom', which referred to the political and cultural sphere influenced by Christianity in Europe. This usage of the term reflects the strong interplay between religion and politics during this period.
